findings.description: Only RecipientRefused is caught. A template KeyError or IndexError from body_template.format (line 57) in render, or any other mailer error such as a connection failure, propagates out of send_campaign. The loop stops midway and the caller gets no CampaignReport. Some recipients have already been mailed, but nothing records which ones. Re-running the campaign then sends duplicates to those recipients.
findings.suggestion: Catch rendering and transport errors per subscriber, record them in the report (for example a `failed` dict), and continue. Or have the report survive the exception so a retry can skip addresses already sent.
findings.title: Render or other send errors abort the whole campaign with no report
